obligations.statement: Every direct element read or write must first establish that the JSArray is stable and the index is below the current element length.
obligations.guard_relation: IsStableJSArray and index < GetElementsLength dominate ElementAccessor::Get/Set
obligations.effect: prevents stale or shrinking backing-store indices from causing out-of-bounds access
limitations: Obligation is derived from the reviewed fix shape and does not prove exploitability.

obligations.statement: A comparator that can execute arbitrary JavaScript must not allow later element access to reuse stale array length or backing-store assumptions.
obligations.guard_relation: array stability and length are revalidated after callback-capable operations
obligations.effect: prevents a resize or backing-store replacement from invalidating the access bound
limitations: Full callback and alias semantics require separate program analysis.
